items.source: Subinterface of Unmarshaller that has support for generics.
items.translation: 支持泛型的 `Unmarshaller` 子接口。

items.source: Indicates whether this marshaller can marshal instances of the supplied generic type.
items.translation: 指示该序列化器是否可以序列化提供的泛型类型的实例。

items.source: true if this marshaller can indeed marshal instances of the supplied type; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此序列化器确实可以序列化提供的类型的实例；否则为 false。

items.source: genericType - the type that this marshaller is being asked if it can marshal
items.translation: genericType - 此编组器被询问是否可以对此类型进行编组。
